answer: A foundry will not list a new caster until one furnace is staffed in person. The caster locks 36 POA as a living ember under the hearth grate, then holds that fire in a 9-degree band for a 55-minute night shift that cannot be split across sockpuppets. Mid-shift an inspector drawn by lot, marked with a falcon tag from another mill, records the grate heat and cuts a jade chip only if the tongs' serial matches the bond ledger. A cold spike or reused tag forfeits a third of the ember; two misses close the stall. Farms fail because one body cannot tend two hearths.
